objectives.text: Establish an advanced technology vehicles manufacturing incentive program providing facility funding awards and a direct loan program to support manufacture of qualifying advanced technology vehicles, components, and ultra efficient vehicles.

citations.quote: §17013. Advanced technology vehicles manufacturing incentive program
the Secretary shall carry out a program to provide loans to eligible individuals and entities (as determined by the Secretary) for the costs of activities described in subsection (b)

obligations.action: provide facility funding awards to automobile manufacturers, ultra efficient vehicle manufacturers, advanced technology vehicle manufacturers, and component suppliers to pay not more than 30 percent of the cost of reequipping, expanding, or establishing a manufacturing facility and engineering integration
obligations.threshold: not more than 30 percent of the cost

citations.quote: The Secretary shall provide facility funding awards under this section to automobile manufacturers, ultra efficient vehicle manufacturers, advanced technology vehicle manufacturers, and component suppliers to pay not more than 30 percent of the cost of-

obligations.action: carry out a program to provide loans to eligible individuals and entities for the costs of activities described in subsection (b)
obligations.trigger: Not later than 1 year after December 19, 2007
exceptions: subject to the availability of appropriated funds

citations.quote: Not later than 1 year after December 19, 2007, and subject to the availability of appropriated funds, the Secretary shall carry out a program to provide loans to eligible individuals and entities (as determined by the Secretary) for the costs of activities described in subsection (b).

obligations.action: make the loans through the Federal Financing Bank, with the full faith and credit of the United States Government on the principal and interest

citations.quote: The loans shall be made through the Federal Financing Bank, with the full faith and credit of the United States Government on the principal and interest.

obligations.action: pay the full credit subsidy using appropriated funds

citations.quote: The full credit subsidy shall be paid by the Secretary using appropriated funds.

obligations.action: pay all laborers and mechanics employed during construction, alteration, or repair financed by a loan wages at rates not less than those prevailing on similar construction in the locality
obligations.trigger: construction, alteration, or repair that is financed, in whole or in part, by a loan under this section
obligations.threshold: rates not less than those prevailing on similar construction in the locality

citations.quote: all laborers and mechanics employed by contractors or subcontractors during construction, alteration, or repair that is financed, in whole or in part, by a loan under this section shall be paid wages at rates not less than those prevailing on similar construction in the locality, as determined by the Secretary of Labor in accordance with sections 3141–​3144, 3146, and 3147 of title 40

obligations.action: select eligible projects to receive loans if the Secretary determines the loan recipient has a reasonable prospect of repaying, will provide sufficient information, has met other criteria, and that the loan amount will be sufficient to carry out the project

citations.quote: The Secretary shall select eligible projects to receive loans under this subsection if the Secretary determines that-

obligations.action: base a determination of reasonable prospect of repayment on a comprehensive evaluation of specified factors

citations.quote: The Secretary shall base a determination of whether there is a reasonable prospect of repayment of the principal and interest on a loan under subparagraph (A)(i)(I) on a comprehensive evaluation of whether the loan recipient has a reasonable prospect of repaying the principal and interest

obligations.action: have an interest rate equal to the cost of funds to the Department of the Treasury for obligations of comparable maturity as of the date the loan is made

citations.quote: shall have an interest rate that, as of the date on which the loan is made, is equal to the cost of funds to the Department of the Treasury for obligations of comparable maturity;

obligations.action: be subject to the condition that the loan is not subordinate to other financing

citations.quote: shall be subject to the condition that the loan is not subordinate to other financing.

obligations.action: certify, for each eligible project selected to receive a loan, that political influence did not impact the selection of the eligible project
obligations.trigger: For each eligible project selected to receive a loan under this subsection

citations.quote: For each eligible project selected to receive a loan under this subsection, the Secretary shall certify that political influence did not impact the selection of the eligible project.

obligations.action: promulgate an interim final rule establishing regulations necessary to administer this section and any loans, requiring that to be eligible an automobile manufacturer's adjusted average fuel economy for the most recent year be not less than its model year 2005 average fuel economy
obligations.trigger: Not later than 60 days after September 30, 2008
obligations.threshold: adjusted average fuel economy not less than the average fuel economy for all light duty vehicles of the manufacturer for model year 2005
exceptions: the Secretary may substitute industry averages for a new manufacturer or a manufacturer that has not previously produced equivalent vehicles

citations.quote: Not later than 60 days after September 30, 2008, the Secretary shall promulgate an interim final rule establishing regulations that the Secretary deems necessary to administer this section and any loans made by the Secretary pursuant to this section.

the adjusted average fuel economy of the manufacturer for light duty vehicles produced by the manufacturer during the most recent year for which data are available shall be not less than the average fuel economy for all light duty vehicles of the manufacturer for model year 2005

obligations.action: substitute industry averages to determine fuel economy baselines for eligibility of a new manufacturer or a manufacturer that has not previously produced equivalent vehicles
obligations.trigger: In order to determine fuel economy baselines for eligibility of a new manufacturer or a manufacturer that has not produced previously produced equivalent vehicles

citations.quote: In order to determine fuel economy baselines for eligibility of a new manufacturer or a manufacturer that has not produced previously produced equivalent vehicles, the Secretary may substitute industry averages.

obligations.action: be no more than $100,000 or 10 basis points of the loan

citations.quote: Administrative costs shall be no more than $100,000 or 10 basis point  2 of the loan.

obligations.action: in making awards or loans to manufacturers with existing facilities, give priority to facilities that are oldest or have been in existence for at least 20 years or are utilized primarily for the manufacture of ultra efficient vehicles
obligations.trigger: in making awards or loans to those manufacturers that have existing facilities

citations.quote: The Secretary shall, in making awards or loans to those manufacturers that have existing facilities, give priority to those facilities that are oldest or have been in existence for at least 20 years or are utilized primarily for the manufacture of ultra efficient vehicles.

obligations.action: use not less than 10 percent of the funds used to provide awards for each fiscal year under subsection (b) to provide awards to covered firms or consortia led by a covered firm
obligations.trigger: Of the amount of funds that are used to provide awards for each fiscal year under subsection (b)

citations.quote: Of the amount of funds that are used to provide awards for each fiscal year under subsection (b), the Secretary shall use not less than 10 percent to provide awards to covered firms or consortia led by a covered firm.

obligations.action: use direct hiring authority pursuant to section 3304(b)(3) of title 5 to appoint professional and administrative personnel deemed necessary

citations.quote: The Secretary may use direct hiring authority pursuant to section 3304(b)(3) of title 5 to appoint such professional and administrative personnel as the Secretary deems necessary to the discharge of the Secretary's functions under this section.

obligations.action: set the rate of pay for a person so appointed to exceed the maximum rate payable for GS-15 of the General Schedule
obligations.threshold: shall not exceed the maximum rate payable for GS-15

citations.quote: The rate of pay for a person appointed pursuant to paragraph (1) shall not exceed the maximum rate payable for GS-15 of the General Schedule under chapter 53

obligations.action: retain such consultants as the Secretary deems necessary to the discharge of functions required by this section

citations.quote: The Secretary may retain such consultants as the Secretary deems necessary to the discharge of the functions required by this section, pursuant to section 1901 of title 41 .

obligations.action: coordinate with relevant vehicle, bioenergy, and hydrogen and fuel cell demonstration project activities supported by the Department

citations.quote: In carrying out this section, the Secretary shall coordinate with relevant vehicle, bioenergy, and hydrogen and fuel cell demonstration project activities supported by the Department.

obligations.action: provide assistance with completion of applications and conduct outreach to disseminate information on awards and loans to potential applicants

citations.quote: In carrying out this section, the Secretary shall-
conduct outreach, including through conferences and online programs, to disseminate information on awards and loans under this section to potential applicants.

obligations.action: submit to Congress a report on the status of projects supported by a loan under this section, including specified data elements

notes: Source contains internal errata flagged by the codifier: subsec. (d)(4)(B)(i) 'and' is noted 'Probably should be "or"'; subsec. (f) '10 basis point' is noted 'Probably should be "points"'; subsec. (i)(2) 'chapter 53 such title 5' is noted 'Probably should be "of such"'. These are extracted as written per the fidelity rule. The $25,000,000,000 loan cap was struck out by Pub. L. 117-169 (2022) and thus is not part of current text. The award/loan periods in subsec. (c) reference dates (December 30, 2020) already elapsed relative to the July 22, 2026 currency statement; extracted as written. Scope note: this DOE ATVM program is a federal manufacturing loan/guarantee-style program; loans made through the Federal Financing Bank with full faith and credit backing fall within the commercial lending subsidy/guarantee mapping scope; facility funding awards under subsec. (b) are grant/award mechanisms treated here as part of the same program authority but border the grants/direct-spending boundary regime.
